issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the method as getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (primitive int). The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) implements the method as public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents() and the solution adds a StudentCount class (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/StudentCount.java). The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) contains a TODO placeholder for this method. This creates a conflicting return type for the same conceptual method across artifacts (int vs StudentCount), which will confuse students about the expected signature and can lead to compilation or test failures if exercise tests or instructions expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Prefer the simpler change: modify the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (e.g. public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() { return numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents; }), update any solution call sites (getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents, getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the int, and remove the StudentCount class from the solution. Alternatively, if the StudentCount wrapper is intended educationally, update the problem statement UML and the template to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount and include the StudentCount class and its API in the template and documentation so students clearly see and use the same type.
